summary: Add HAL's _embedded to dataEnvelopeKeys so an exhausted eLumen page is recognized as empty, and correct the --diff-only description in courses compare and which.
reason: eLumen returns {"_embedded":{"courses":[...]},"_links":{...},"pagination":{...}}. _embedded was not in dataEnvelopeKeys, so isEmptyPageResponse could not see that an exhausted page holds an empty item array; syncResource then fell through to its single-object path and failed the whole resource with 'missing id for courses'. This is reachable whenever a stored cursor points past the end of a filtered result set - it is exactly what happened running the sync command that `courses compare --help` prescribes against an already-populated mirror. Separately, the compare long help claimed --diff-only 'collapses identical colleges', but courses_compare.go only nulls the rows when every college matches; the flag's own one-line description was already accurate.
validated_outcome: New TestIsEmptyPageResponseHandlesHALEmbedded fails on the pre-patch envelope list (exhausted page and programs cases) and passes with _embedded added; TestExtractPageItemsHandlesHALEmbedded confirms a populated HAL page still yields its items, so the added key cannot turn a full page into an empty one. `courses compare ACCTG 001` still returns 9 colleges and 3 distinct profiles. Full Go suite passes.
